caption:
The 1970 Mustang Mach 1 Twister Special is one of the rarest and wildest street-legal Mustangs ever built. Originally planned as pace cars, only 96 were made—48 with the legendary 428 Super Cobra Jet V8. Finished in Grabber Orange with black stripes and a tornado decal, these cars came equipped with Drag Pack suspension and were quarter-mile killers. Built only for Kansas dealers, they’ve become holy grails for collectors—one recently sold for over $250,000. A true American muscle legend.
